description:
Payload for ``message_type='accept'``.

When sent by the coordinator: confirms negotiation is complete.
When sent by the requester: approves the proposed execution plan.

output_schema.description: Merged JSON Schema describing the combined output that the requester will receive upon completion.  Built from the individual output schemas of all accepted offers.
output_schema.title: Output Schema

approval_note.description: Optional note from the requester explaining the approval.
approval_note.title: Approval Note

title: LIP accept payload
